blocks.accepted_litex:
have fn positive_part(x R) R by cases:
    case x >= 0: x
    case x < 0: 0

have algo for positive_part(x):
    case x >= 0: x
    case x < 0: 0

claim:
    ? forall x R:
        0 <= positive_part(x)
    by cases:
        ? 0 <= positive_part(x)
        case x >= 0:
            0 <= x = positive_part(x)
        case x < 0:
            0 <= 0 = positive_part(x)
blocks.reusable_lesson: one comparison/equality chain per branch is both the mathematical proof and the smallest verified rewrite bridge

blocks.accepted_litex:
have fn newton_sqrt_two(x R+) R+ = (x + 2 / x) / 2

# This is the exact sequence whose residual bound is proved.
have fn sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n N) R+ by induc n from 0:
    case n = 0: 1
    case n > 0: newton_sqrt_two(sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n - 1))

# The proved iteration stays positive and never uses this zero restart.
have fn newton_sqrt_two_step(x R) R by cases:
    case x = 0: 1
    case x != 0: (x + 2 / x) / 2

have algo for newton_sqrt_two_step(x):
    case x = 0: 1
    case x != 0: (x + 2 / x) / 2

claim:
    ? forall x R+:
        newton_sqrt_two_step(x) = newton_sqrt_two(x)
    newton_sqrt_two_step(x) = (x + 2 / x) / 2 = newton_sqrt_two(x)
blocks.reusable_lesson: keep the proved recursive mathematical object visible even when the current backend extracts only its single-step implementation
